s.note: the orange mints Bleeker can't stop eating
s.how: Roast 200g almonds and 200g cashews at 180C for 10 minutes. Toss while hot with the zest of one orange, a tablespoon of sugar and a good pinch of sea salt flakes. Cool on the tray, then serve in a bowl beside some orange-flavoured mints.

Shape 500g beef mince into 8 small patties and season well. Fry for 2 minutes a side, adding a slice of cheddar to each at the end. Split 8 slider buns, add tomato sauce and pickles, then stack the patties in and push a toothpick through each one.

m.how: Brown 500g beef mince with a diced onion. Add 200g sliced mushrooms and cook down, then stir in a cup each of corn and green beans and 300ml cream. Spread in a baking dish, cover with neat rows of potato gems and bake at 200C for 35 minutes until golden.

w.note: the corner store where Juno buys the tests
w.how: Make up 2 packets of blue jelly to the packet directions and pour into 4 clear cups. Chill for 3 hours until set. Just before serving, top each with a scoop of lemon sorbet and a little whipped cream, then add a straw and a spoon.

d.note: Juno drinking orange juice straight from the jug
d.how: Juice 8 oranges into a big jug over plenty of ice. Stir in 250ml mango nectar, then top up with 500ml cold soda water just before serving so it keeps some fizz. Add a few orange slices to the jug and pour into tall glasses.
